headline: StarHub to Merge With M1 by Mid-2027 and Acquire Circles.Life
summary: Singapore telecoms operator StarHub agreed to merge with M1 by mid-2027 and acquire Circles.Life in a separate transaction, consolidating the city-state's mobile and telecommunications market.
why: Telecom consolidation reduces price competition in saturated markets, boosting operational scale, cash generation, and spectrum efficiency.

impacts.name: StarHub
impacts.why: StarHub is executing a merger with competitor M1 and acquiring MVNO Circles.Life.
